source.other:
The replay has desynced and the game was paused.
You are probably watching a replay created with another version of Widelands, which is not supported.

If you are certain that the replay was created with the same version of Widelands, %1$s, please report this problem as a bug.
You will find related messages in the standard output (stdout.txt on Windows). Please add this information to your report.

target.other:
Reprisen har hamnat ur synk och spelet har pausats.
Du tittar troligen på en repris som har skapats med en annan version av Widelands, vilket inte stöds.

Om du är säker på att reprisen skapades med samma version av Widelands, %1$s, rapportera problemet som en bugg.
Du hittar relaterade meddelanden i standardutdata (stdout.txt i Windows). Bifoga denna information till din rapport.

key:
